description: Defines the SearchBlockForm class for building a search form block in Drupal, including dependencies, form construction, and submission handling.

classes.name: SearchBlockForm
classes.description: Builds and manages the search form block, handling form creation, default search page retrieval, and form submission.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchBlockForm with dependencies: search page repository, config factory, and renderer.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the search form, setting action URL, method, and form elements based on the default or specified search page.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission; actual processing delegated to the search page.
